differential.name: Chronic kidney disease, stage 4 secondary to hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Markedly elevated creatinine (3.2 mg/dL) in a hypertensive, older adult with anemia suggests advanced CKD from long‑standing hypertension.

differential.name: Diabetic kidney disease (early diabetic nephropathy)
differential.rationale: Prediabetes, dyslipidemia, and metabolic syndrome increase risk; could contribute to CKD alongside hypertension.

differential.name: Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
differential.rationale: Mild ALT elevation (51.7 U/L) with normal AST, dyslipidemia, and obesity‑related risk factors point to NAFLD.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease (renal anemia)
differential.rationale: Anemia in the setting of CKD and chronic inflammation (sepsis history, chronic pain) is typical of anemia of chronic disease.

differential.name: Essential hypertension (uncontrolled)
differential.rationale: Persistent elevated BP (147/90 mmHg) drives both renal injury and cardiovascular risk.
